notes.title: Update 4.0.0! A New Game Mode - Routes!
notes.content:
[h2]Overview[/h2][p]The wait is finally over! Our new game mode Routes is finally here! After A YEAR of development effort, 2 public playtests, and A TON of community feedback, we are beyond thrilled to get our new game mode in to your hands!

Enough of our blabbering, check out our trailer below![/p][previewyoutube="42uWFR0DoR8;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]
Highlights[/h2][p]A lot can change over the course of a year, so let's break down some of the biggest changes that have arrived in this release!
[/p][h3]Routes[/h3][p]Players can now jump back into CCE and enjoy a new game mode for every level that exists in the game! For now, we've chosen to only release the EASY route for each game mode, but the other difficulties are coming soon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/53ce5421146f599ffc3b8afe88e21d1e66f2198e.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Meteor Select Overhaul[/h3][p]The Meteor Select menu has been completely overhauled! Now, after a player selects a new meteor, they will be presented with mode and difficulty select options.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/82c998e82914e7bbd2962e809cff34c0437f6b22.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Route Leaderboards![/h3][p]Each new Route comes with its own dedicated leaderboard, letting players compete for the top spot on any Route difficulty, globally or with friends.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/06ff9d4448e3b611084e85c257fa7ab65d9ee9f2.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Community Spotlight[/h2][p]We recently sat down with a member of our Discord Community to talk Command Center Earth and dive into the new Routes mode. Check out the video below for a behind-the-scenes look!
[/p][previewyoutube="4qx3nU8f5qg;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Routes Final Playtesting Starting Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Overview[/h2]
Hey everyone! We're pumped announce that we are finally getting very close to releasing our new game mode, Routes! With that said we're looking to get one final round of Playtesting in before it's released. That means we need your help!

Check out a sneak peak below!
[previewyoutube=5DkEYVsOLMw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're interested in being a part of the Playtest, request access by hitting that big green "Request Access" button on the store page!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/60128a7a81d63e4b318f1bdcdaee66e48fbc7716.png[/img]

[i][b]Invited to the playtest with a Steam key? Go ahead and activate the Playtest like you would activate any other game on Steam! The Playtest should then show up in your library.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/3322127ca559a02d32157a7ee8d514b12f5e5cd5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Testing FAQ[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Where can I access a level route?[/b]

Glad you asked! Navigate to the meteor select screen and do the following when any Meteor is visible. Press "Launch" Button ➡ Press Down to select "Routes" ➡ Press "Launch" button ➡ Press Up to select "Easy" ➡ Press "Launch" button! 

If that was as confusing to you as it was to us, just check the the gif below 😅!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/82c998e82914e7bbd2962e809cff34c0437f6b22.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Why is the Launch button disabled when Routes is selected in the Meteor Select menu?[/b]

Routes require the standard level to be completed before you can access them. Complete the standard mode of the level and the Routes will unlock!

Feel it should work another way? Leave us some feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/13ca06a4b6c71b217c8911d4806a3a699ae64690.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Why is the Launch button disabled when Medium or Hard Route is selected in the Meteor Select menu?[/b]

Medium and Hard Routes are not yet available, but will be coming soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/b681bc0e3e047c61668479e82ff9f0e7ec622961.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Where can I leave you feedback for routes?[/b]

Navigate to the main menu and click the pencil icon button! That should take you to our feedback form where you can give us all the feedback you have the strength to convey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/e7ec09e647b37009865c61170b1a73191944d0dc.jpg[/img]
[/list]

Thanks so much for your interest in the routes playtest! Remember a playtest is only as good as the feedback we can collect, so please don't forget to jot down your thoughts about routes in our feedback form or our discord 🙏!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/fe1bfc491a84a5b20c0ef775732879d2ae1b3b45.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/54da4e2301136694497c78c5097d6382423c24fb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 3.2.0! UI Overhaul!
notes.content:
While we’ve been hard at work preparing Routes for release (see [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2639860/view/4274565771153449986?l=english]playtest details here![/url]), we've also been hard at work tackling another project: a complete UI overhaul!

[h2]Main Menu[/h2]
Let's dive right in and check out how our main menu has changed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/9af53adfc2b77facd055a2ecf33c7c63e6c8327a.gif[/img]

To start things off you can see that our start game button has been overhauled to make it more apparent when that button is selected. Additionally all of our icons in the game, including those found on the "File Buttons" have been overhauled to ensure they are more stylistically similar.

[h2]Button States[/h2]

A major part of our UI overhaul involved creating a cohesive look for all buttons across various states. The goal was to ensure the button states worked for all our current input. Our main inputs targeted were Mouse + Keyboard, Controller, and Touch input! Let’s take a look at the 'File Button' as an example to show how each button behaves consistently in each state.

[h3]Hover[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/9ac40098050fa30ec55fba50d80aa56b9413773e.gif[/img]

[h3]Selected[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/b1d9afce0d1e7441a86d0d6795af84c5e18e4800.gif[/img]

[h3]Selected Hover[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/b27784d5e9729c0eb354069adbbe5178e6bf661f.gif[/img]

[h3]Pressed[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/5997890845cfc54396e930e010523af0acb3a636.gif[/img]

[h2]Settings Menu[/h2]

The settings menu is a great example of both the icon and button state updates so let's have a look at the before and after to see how things changed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/ba95d883f5a42b760137f5714f8d329328e436aa.gif[/img]

Immediately we can see that our social links have changed from a solid green to an outline. Under our new button state rules a button should only show (with few exceptions) as solid green if it is selected. This made the social buttons an easy target for some visual updates. As a result of the updates we can now more easily tell which button is currently selected on screen.

Additionally if we turn our attention to our audio (icon) button we can see that it's look has been refined and its stroke has been reduced to fall in line with the changes to all our icons.

Finally if we turn our attention to our credits button, we can see that the glow has been removed in accordance with our button state rules. This adjustment makes it clearer when a hover has occurred, distinguishing it from other states like selection, for a more intuitive user experience.

[h2]Secondary Button Bounce[/h2]

Let's have a look at our previous "Post Level" menus to see a small but annoying issue that was occurring with our "Secondary Buttons". That is the "Main Menu" and "Restart" buttons show in the gif below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/410c56aeff743dd200dbd45e2529d66a0f109049.gif[/img]

We can see from the gif above that when we change our selection to a "Secondary Button" a margin is added to the button creating a disorienting "bounce" effect.

Let's now take a look at our new "Post Level" menu to see how fixing this issue can lead to a more pleasant navigation experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/9ecd6b95d7bd50002ed666dba50be59814b74652.gif[/img]

[h2]Mobile & More[/h2]

A major reason for the UI overhaul was to establish clear guidelines for updating and creating both current and future UIs across all targeted platforms. The goal of these guidelines is to streamline the process of delivering game updates with UI changes to players across all platforms. With these new guidelines in place, we’re aiming to deliver game updates to you faster across all targeted platforms!

For all the UI/UX nerds out there, here's peek behind the scenes at CCE's design library.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/ec54b8f53ce27ae6ed74b1a98da151826361e480.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

There was bug flying under the radar that was causing friend leaderboards to fail to load. This bug was only manifesting when a player had fellow Steam friends who had purchased CCE. This bug has been fixed, so friend leaderboards should now load displaying any Steam friends who have purchased the game!

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

We would love to hear your thoughts on the new update so please feel free to reach out via our Discord, or by leaving a comment below! Additionally if you've purchased CCE and are enjoying it, don't forget that one of the best ways to show your support is to leave us a review :).

notes.title: Routes Playtesting Starting Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Overview[/h2]
We've been hard at work bringing a new game mode to CCE! We call it, Routes!

Check out a Sneak Peak below!
[previewyoutube=5amnu47lfR0;full][/previewyoutube]

In order to ensure this game mode is the best it can possibly be, we're going to need your help with some feedback!

If you're interested request access to the Playtest by hitting that big green "Request Access" button on the store page!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/60128a7a81d63e4b318f1bdcdaee66e48fbc7716.png[/img]

[h2]Testing FAQ[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Where can I access a level route?[/b]

Glad you asked! Navigate to the meteor select screen and find a meteor with the routes button showing. Currently it appears like this! Once you've found that button, click it to start playing a route!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/ea5efaf1cd370ba187f493f067e60a17d88ea6e6.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Where can I leave you feedback for routes?[/b]

Navigate to the main menu and click the pencil icon button! That should take you to our discord where you can give us all the feedback you have the strength to convey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/e7ec09e647b37009865c61170b1a73191944d0dc.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]This new routes mode is hard to access and is buggy, what gives?[/b]

We really wanted to get this new game mode in the hands of the people as quickly as we could in order to get some much needed feedback! For that reason, the UI for accessing a level route is pretty unintuitive and routes may be buggy.

Rest assured that all these UI / UX quirks and buggy behavior will be ironed out before the launch!
[/list]

Thanks so much for your interest in the routes playtest! Remember a playtest is only as good as the feedback we can collect, so please don't forget to jot down your thoughts about routes in our discord 🙏!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/54da4e2301136694497c78c5097d6382423c24fb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 3.1.0! Get Ready To Self Destruct!
notes.content:
Gone are the days of finding the closest rock to crash into just so you can start again!

Pilots can now remotely detonate the ISJ-10 when failure is inevitable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/3f19237a1f8d8fff8c7044553969aea09480cd55.gif[/img]

The Command Center has also been updated so each pilots can reference the self destruct functionality both before and during a mission!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717390/df1b55db624850b78cf29f90f9ccf3ed75c8822d.gif[/img]

Alongside these enhancements a slew of bug fixes have also been rolled out to the Command Center!
